name: VERTICAL TUBE FURNACE
desc: Premium Vertical Tube Furnace engineered for high-temperature heating, sintering, and annealing of samples in an inert atmosphere. As a trusted manufacturer, Innolab Instruments designs these furnaces with premium heating elements and an advanced 30-segment programmable digital controller.
